description: Frictionless per-session capture ("daily note for agents"). Keyed by source "session:<session_id>": the first call creates one session memory (document_type "session"); every later call for the same session_id appends to that same memory (newline-joined, re-embedded and versioned). Different session_ids stay isolated. Returns { memory_id, created, appended }.

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

session_id.description: Session identifier. The note is keyed by source "session:<session_id>" — the first call creates the memory, later calls append to that same one.

text.description: Text to capture (created as content, or appended newline-joined to the session note).

title.description: Optional title used only on create (defaults to "Session <session_id>").

name: memory_session_note
